title: Drift through the Okefenokee Swamp
description: A guided boat moves slowly through dark water beneath cypress trees and hanging moss. Look for reflected sky, floating plants, turtles, and alligators as the guide explains why the Okefenokee is a living wetland rather than just a backdrop. The stillness and unfamiliar sounds make the trip feel far from the roads outside the refuge.
teaser: Take a guided boat into a cypress-lined wetland.
goodToKnow: Before you go, check winter departures, boat transfers and cold-weather comfort. No swimming is needed.
whyItMightDelightYou: The swamp asks you to slow your eyes down until you start noticing what was hidden in plain sight.
